source_project: Stanford/Hitachi ContractNLI, CC BY 4.0 original human-annotated test dataset, https://stanfordnlp.github.io/contract-nli/
hypothesis: Receiving Party may retain some Confidential Information even after the return or destruction of Confidential Information.
selection: same fixed NDA-20 hypothesis across six distinct public contracts; two of each human gold class selected by predeclared sha256(document id), no human evidence spans in model retrieval; labels hidden in model prompts and separate scoring
source_retrieval: top3 automatic hypothesis-to-document sentence span Jaccard + local span neighbors; excerpt capped 2300 chars, original source and full gold retained in tmp
